### ✨ Starward Mod Menu (v3.3.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Starward** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **One-Hit Kill** — Instantly eliminates any hit enemy
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiplies all outgoing damage dealt to enemies
- **Max Outgoing Damage Ratio** — Boosts outgoing damage curve ratio
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Blocks all incoming damage & death triggers
- **Auto Lock Full HP** — Locks player HP to Max HP
- **Infinite Shield Absorb** — Player shield never loses absorb capacity
- **Dumb Enemies (Freeze AI)** — Freezes enemy AI movement & attacks
- **Bypass Enemy Shields** — Ignores enemy shield hit absorption
- **Freeze Enemy HP (Combo Practice)** — Enemies take `0` damage for combo practice
- **Unlimited Ammo & Ex Skills** — Prevents ammo consumption & auto-refills skills
- **Infinite Boost / Flight Gauge** — Locks flight & dash gauge to maximum
- **Game Speed Multiplier (`1.0x – 5.0x`)** — Accelerates gameplay time scale
- **Target Frame Rate (`30 – 120 FPS`)** — Unlocks maximum rendering FPS

### 🛡️ Protection
- **1-User License**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
